content.value: . A DC shunt motor gives 3000 rpm ofrotation by taking 10 kW power at 100 A load. Given that, the motor is wave wound with four pole, producing magnetic flux of 5 m Wb. If the motor armature has 200 number of conductors, then i) What will be the back emf developed in the motor?,
ii) If the motor is lap wound, then what will be number of armature conductor required to produce the same mechanical rotation?
